capabilities: Define custom regex rulesets as text files
Apply rulesets to notes or selections via sidebar, right-click menu, or commands
Transform selected content (e.g. into a two-column table)
Organize rulesets through an index file in .obsidian/regex-rulesets/
extras: The README recommends a third-party writeup for beginners unfamiliar with regex, and points to a samples folder for more example rulesets. FAQ covers a UTF-8 encoding pitfall for ruleset files.
motivation: The README says it is especially useful for building personal knowledge databases, where notes clipped from the same webpages need repeated cleanup.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run reusable, user-defined regex transformations on notes, which is tedious when clipping from the same sources repeatedly.

relations.evidence: Markdownload ( for clipping webpages, don't forget to configure it to match your editing preferences.

summary: Regex ruleset plugin that lets users define custom find-and-replace pipelines to automatically format note content.
